description: This file contains shell script test cases designed to verify the behavior of a git clone operation, including custom SSH command behavior and the invocation of specific git upload-pack commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test expectation with a description and command block.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs the command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs, used for validation.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test sequence.
